Lexicon.record.doc: Record that a surface form points at a Riemann zero, optionally within a semantic domain.

params.domain: semantic domain name; None records globally only

Lexicon.record_file.doc: Mark a file as processed so already_seen() reports it.

Lexicon.already_seen.doc: Report whether a file has been recorded by record_file().
Lexicon.already_seen.returns: True if the file was already processed

Lexicon.faces.doc:
Return the top surface forms for a Riemann zero.

If a domain is given, restrict to it first and fall back to the global set.

params.domain: semantic domain name; None uses the global set

Lexicon.best_face.doc: Return the single most-seen surface form for a prime: the engine's best answer to "what word is this?"

params.domain: semantic domain name; None uses the global set
params.language_hint: preferred language when several faces tie

Lexicon.best_face.returns: the best surface form, or None if the zero has no faces

Lexicon.face_count.returns: the number of distinct surface forms pointing at this zero

Lexicon.save.doc: Save the lexicon to disk as JSON.

params.path: destination file; None uses the lexicon's own path

Lexicon.load.doc: Load the lexicon from a JSON file on disk.

params.path: source file; None uses the lexicon's own path

Lexicon.merge.doc: Merge another lexicon into this one.

params.other: the lexicon whose faces, domains and seen-files are added

Lexicon.stats.returns: unique primes, unique faces, total tokens, files seen and domains indexed
